ns2:course.label: Intro Kines & Community Health
ns2:course.description: Serves as an introduction to the Kinesiology and Community Health Department and provides an overview of the Kinesiology and Community Health curricula, areas of study, and opportunities available for careers in the field. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Credit will not be given for both CHLH 111 and KIN 125.
